components.name: Refresh
components.description: The sole action; hover, pressed, focus and declared disabled styling. Current renderer does not set disabled.
components.css: .ds-example { font: 14px/1.5 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; color: var(--on, #edf5f4); background: var(--ink, #08171c); } .ds-icon { width:20px; height:20px; flex:none; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.7; stroke-linecap:square; stroke-linejoin:miter; color:var(--on-2, #a6c3c8); } @media (forced-colors:active) { .ds-icon { color:CanvasText; } } .ds-refresh { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--rule-strong, #44798a); border-radius:0; color:var(--on, #edf5f4); background:transparent; font:700 11px/1.5 Archivo,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-refresh:hover { background:var(--ink-3, #132c36); } .ds-refresh:active { background:var(--ink-2, #0d2029); } .ds-refresh:disabled { color:var(--on-3, #7c9aa2); cursor:wait; } .ds-refresh:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #a6c3c8); outline-offset:3px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-refresh { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview:
A compact, ruled evidence sheet in petrol ink, with Archivo typography and neutral outline signposts. Flat surfaces and off-white text keep dense evidence readable without assigning a reassuring or alarming color to its meaning.

This captures the approved September 12, 2026 panel implementation only. It does not prescribe the design of injected card annotations. The extension retains a distinct identity beside Landing.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral icons paired with explicit words.
Full evidence wording in a continuous, wrapping document.

rules.name: The Neutral Evidence Rule
rules.body: Status is stated in words; icons and color never replace those words or imply a condition rating.

dos: Do preserve full labels, source caveats and unavailable or older-check wording.
Do keep the panel in normal document flow and let narrow layouts stack.
Do retain local fonts, local SVG assets and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't apply this panel palette to injected card annotations without a separate design decision.
Don't use condition colors or icon-only evidence statuses.
Don't add decorative controls, photographs, rounded cards or shadows to this approved panel.
